name: JSON Formatter
description: Format, beautify and validate JSON data directly in your browser.
longDescription: A fast browser-based JSON formatter, beautifier, and minifier with syntax checking, configurable tab spacing, and instant copy capabilities.

name: JSON Validator
description: Validate JSON payloads with line and column error pointers.
longDescription: Detect syntax errors in JSON objects instantly with exact error position markers, structure diagnostics, and depth analysis.

name: Base64 Encoder / Decoder
description: Encode and decode raw strings and text files into standard or URL-safe Base64.
longDescription: Easily convert UTF-8 text or binary files into standard or URL-safe Base64 strings with zero server roundtrips.

name: UUID Generator
description: Generate cryptographically secure RFC 4122 v4 UUID identifiers in bulk.
longDescription: Produce single or bulk UUID v4 strings with uppercase/lowercase formatting, hyphen removal toggles, and instant clipboard export.

name: Password Generator
description: Generate strong, randomized passwords with customizable complexity and strength scoring.
longDescription: Client-side CSPRNG secure password generator with customizable length, symbols, numbers, ambiguous character filters, and entropy calculation.

name: URL Encoder / Decoder
description: Encode and decode URLs, URI components, and inspect query parameter key-value pairs.
longDescription: Safe percent-encoding and decoding for web addresses, query strings, and deep linking parameters with a built-in query params inspector.

name: Timestamp Converter
description: Convert Unix epoch timestamps to human readable dates (UTC & Local) and vice-versa.
longDescription: Convert Unix timestamps in seconds or milliseconds into ISO 8601, RFC 2822, and localized date formats with live countdown and relative time calculations.

name: Color Converter
description: Convert between HEX, RGB, HSL, HSV, and CMYK with live color picker and contrast checker.
longDescription: Explore color spaces seamlessly with real-time conversion between HEX, RGB, HSL, and CMYK formats, color preview, and WCAG AA/AAA contrast ratios.

name: Slug Generator
description: Convert headlines and titles into SEO-friendly, URL-safe slugs with custom delimiters.
longDescription: Generate clean URLs from articles or blog titles with diacritic normalization, custom separators, and duplicate whitespace removal.

name: Word Counter
description: Analyze text metrics including words, characters, sentences, paragraphs, and reading time.
longDescription: A comprehensive live text analyzer providing real-time counts for words, characters with/without spaces, sentences, paragraphs, estimated reading time, and speaking time.

name: QR Code Generator
description: Generate downloadable QR codes for URLs, Wi-Fi, contacts, and text client-side.
longDescription: Create high-resolution QR codes entirely inside your browser with custom error correction levels, size scaling, and instant PNG download.

name: Text Case Converter
description: Convert text into camelCase, snake_case, kebab-case, UPPERCASE, Title Case, and more.
longDescription: Instantly transform text strings across popular developer and editorial case formats: UPPERCASE, lowercase, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case, CONSTANT_CASE, and Title Case.
